name: Wingspan
description: Engine-building card game for 1–5 bird lovers: attract birds to forest, grassland and wetland, and chain their powers.

intro: **Built from the official rulebook** by Stonemaier Games (WS_Rulebook r24), linked from their [Wingspan rules page](https://stonemaiergames.com/games/wingspan/rules/).
The text was transcribed from the PDF's pages, and the cards, icons and diagrams sit next to the rules they belong to. Tap any page image to see it as printed.
The same Stonemaier page also has the **Appendix** (every bird power, bonus card and goal), the Swift-Start guides and the solo Automa rules.
Card art and diagrams © Stonemaier Games; bird art by Natalia Rojas, Ana María Martínez Jaramillo and Beth Sobel. Food, habitat and nest icons from the fan projects Wingsearch and Wingspan Utilities.
